span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A bandpass filter in the auditory system whose passband is about 13.5 db wider than the ideal filter admits proportionally more noise power, so the detector behaves exactly like the ideal detector but requires a correspondingly higher signal-to-noise ratio.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: When two signal components fall in non-overlapping auditory filters, the two filter outputs are statistically independent, so the two detectors' decisions are independent as well.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A decision based on the signs of two independent detector outputs can never beat the better single detector, which is why the 500+1100 cps signal is only as detectable as its more detectable component.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: forced-choice → yes-no
span.note: PROVED INDISTINGUISHABLE - the FORMAL form (Q-286/Q-287). The strongest version of the claim we cannot express: not 'we could not tell them apart' but 'they cannot be told apart', established by argument and holding for a whole class of methods. THE CASE THAT JOINS THE TWO GAPS. 'do not differ at all AS FAR AS THE FUNDAMENTAL THEOREM IS CONCERNED' is a non-difference SCOPED TO A NAMED RESPECT. We cannot say a relation fails, and we cannot say what a relation is relative to; this one clause needs both. If `differs_in` is built, design against this sentence.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: detectors → the paper's own definition of detection
span.note: A METALINGUISTIC SELF-CAUTION, AND THE VOCABULARY HAS NO TYPE FOR A CLAIM ABOUT A WORD. `Quotation withheld` The author uses a term his own definition forbids and says so. The relation is not between two concepts in the paper - it is between A USAGE and THE DEFINITION THAT USAGE VIOLATES. I first wrote `detectors --distinct-from--> value` and the gate refused it for want of a differentiation cue, correctly: those two are not comparable things, and the edge was a bad rendering of a real observation. **The observation survives here; the edge does not.** Note that the term reaches signal-detection engineering with the caution stripped off. Reached 2026-08-26 by terminal-a.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `the subject's criterion` - A NAME THAT MAKES A PREDICTION, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO AS IT COINS IT. `the central-tendency term, c, IS CALLED "THE SUBJECT'S CRITERION." THIS SUGGESTS A "PSYCHOLOGICAL" QUANTITY WHICH MAY, AS PSYCHOLOGICAL QUANTITIES SOMETIMES DO, CHANGE ITS VALUE FROM PSYCHOPHYSICAL EXPERIMENT TO EXPERIMENT.` **The name is a parameter of a model; calling it the subject's turns a fitted constant into a property of a person, and the paper flags the consequence rather than the word.**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `detectors` - THE AUTHOR USES A WORD HIS OWN DEFINITION FORBIDS, AND LABELS IT AS LOOSE. `Quotation withheld` Detection is defined in this paper through payoff, and a machine has no payoffs. **The term survives into signal-detection engineering with the caution stripped off** - which is the ordinary fate of a hedged coinage. **NO EDGE PROPOSED.** The natural endpoints would be `detectors` and `organisms`, and the gate refused `detectors --distinct-from--> value` for want of a differentiation cue - correctly, since those two are not comparable things. The claim is metalinguistic (a word is being used loosely), and the sense layer is where a claim about a word belongs.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `value` - A TECHNICAL TERM PINNED BY AN EVERYDAY ANALOGY INSTEAD OF A DEFINITION. `Quotation withheld` No utility function, no axioms - an appeal to shared usage, in a paper that is otherwise formal to the point of listing its notation. The looseness is deliberate and local.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Human listeners were far less sensitive than the ideal detector: the ideal detector reaches 75 per cent correct at a signal-energy-to-noise-spectrum ratio of 1.4, whereas the subjects needed a ratio of about 15, i.e. roughly 13.5 db more signal.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Once the ideal-detector curve was shifted rightward by a single constant, it fitted the observed psychophysical functions closely, accounting for 99.3 per cent of the variance in the best case and 97.3 per cent in the worst.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Apart from a constant loss of about 13.5 db in sensitivity, the subjects' detection behaviour matched the ideal detector's predicted psychophysical function for pure tones.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: For two-component signals at 1060 and 1100 cps, detectability was set by the total energy of the signal, exactly as for the ideal detector, and the energy-summation prediction accounted for 96.5 per cent of the observed variance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: For two-component signals at 500 and 1100 cps the energy-summation prediction collapsed, accounting for only 25 per cent of the variance; detectability was instead set by the more detectable component alone, which accounted for 93.5 per cent.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Predicting the 500+1100 cps two-tone detectability from the better single component alone accounted for 93.5 per cent of the variance and a t-test found no difference between that component's detectability and the two-tone detectability.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Two-component signals at 500 and 540 cps fell between the two extremes, with the energy-summation prediction accounting for 73.6 per cent of the variance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: For the 1060/1100 and 500/540 pairs, adding the weaker component raised the detectability of the whole signal above that of the stronger component alone, a difference that was highly significant.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The 13.5 db loss cannot be internal noise adding linearly to external noise, because detection accuracy stays constant whenever the external signal-to-noise ratio is constant, no matter how loud the noise.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because 1060+1100 cps behaved as a single band while 500+540 cps did not, the auditory filters near 1100 cps must be wider than those near 500 cps — which independently predicts the poorer 1100 cps detectability measured in Experiment 1.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
